item.tib: tshe dbang drag khros kyi sngon 'gro bsnyen pa'i gzhi ma sgo dgu
item.coloph: de ltar sngon 'gro bsnyen pa'i rim pa 'di/ 'gro la phan phyir tshe dbang bdag gis bgyis/ mkhan po g.yung drung gsal 'baral sogs te/ rjes dbang rnams la zab mo'i bka' 'di gtad/ skabs zhig bon chos nyi zla 'char nub dus/ bA+ai ro la sogs rig 'dzin du ma yi/ lo tsa mkhas pa'i d+ha ris dag la bsdus/ zhang zhung sgo mo rtse drug nub byang mtshams/ dbal ri'i gnas tshab rin chen 'bar ba'i brag tsi rta 'dra ba'i brag la gter du sbos/ phyis su rten 'brel rnam pa lnga shar tshe/ nges med sprul sku gcig gis rnyed par shog/ phyis su sems dpa'i (dpa') thugs rje nyi ma bdag gis/ phug leb 'o ma stag rtse'i gnas kyi nye 'dabs tsi rta 'dra ba'i brag dmar ngos nas shog ser la dril zhig rnyed ste (de) / lo mang bka' rgya sdom/ slar smon sras rin po che dang*/ hor sras bsod nams rgyal mtshan mchog gi (gis) lha rdzas kyi (kyis) sna drang ste (drangs te)/ bka' chab yang yang pheb (phab) pa dang*/ de mtshungs grwa rgyal bstan ye tshul g.yung drung 'od zer sogs kyis nye bar bskul ngor/ gshen gyi bla brang du gtan la phab pa'o//
